title: The four eons of Earth's history
trouble: Rereading feels like knowing; it is not. Recall, then check.

blocks.html: Earth is about 4.5 billion years old, and geologists split that long story into four huge chapters called eons. Knowing them gives you a frame for everything else: fossils, mountains, and how short human history is.

How to hold it: Four items fit in working memory at once, so learn them as one chunk. The names tell the story if you know their Greek roots: Hades (fiery start), archaios (ancient), proteros + zoe (earlier life), phaneros + zoe (visible life). Make it a four-panel comic: a fiery ball, a rock with a speck of life, green slime and bubbles of oxygen, then a busy sea of creatures.
